versions.changelog: Link public source repo (Ed25519 notarization MCP server, verified live).

Sharpen positioning: we verify the claim is true (resolver against GitHub/Kalshi/on-chain/price feeds), not just that a receipt wasn't forged, unlike other notary/attestation skills here. Add scripts/verify_offline.cjs — zero-network Ed25519 tamper check against a single receipt, closing the single-point-of-failure gap vs local-only verifiers.
Initial listing: machine-payable, Ed25519-signed claim verification (github_pr, onchain_tx, kalshi_market, url_json, http_status, price_oracle resolvers). Free tier + x402-paid.
